detail.longDescription:
New on dev.to: inbuxa, a Stalwart fork where multi-tenancy, SCIM 2.0, undelete, masked addresses, legal holds and DLP are all in the free AGPL-3.0 install. No license key, no paid tier.

One Rust binary for JMAP/IMAP/SMTP/DAV, and no web UI on the mail host.

Bonus: masked addresses & account security now work natively in Bulwark against inbuxa (#1522, #1534).

👉 [https://dev.to/stefan_sabolowitsch_3bd10/inbuxa-a-stalwart-fork-where-every-enterprise-feature-is-in-the-free-install-3i39]

Disclosure: I contribute to inbuxa & Bulwark.
